withheld_reason.contributions: THE RETAINED DOCUMENT HAS NO SCHEDULE A AND NO SUMMARY PAGE AT ALL. `pdfinfo` reports Pages: 2, and both were read full-page: p1 is the cover ('FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES') and p2 is a SCHEDULE B sheet ('ITEMIZED EXPENDITURES MADE'), classified from its own printed heading. There is therefore no Schedule A page that exists-and-is-blank (which would be `empty-schedule`) and no contributions figure anywhere in the document - not on a summary page, not on a cover cell. This is non-existence, a property of the document as the county published it, not a failed read and not an assertion that the filer received nothing. The filer's own foliation on p2 reads 'Page 1' with the 'of' box left blank, so it does not say how many sheets the filing should have; a GRAMA re-fetch is the only way to learn whether a Schedule A was ever filed.

expenditures.anchor: Schedule B's OWN TWO PRINTED FOOTERS on p2 - 'Subtotal for this page $300' and 'Total Expenditures (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages) $300'. THERE IS NO COLUMN A ON THIS FILING: the document has no summary page, so no cover cross-check exists and none was synthesized
expenditures.detail: The 2 Schedule B rows sum to 100.00 + 200.00 = 300.00 EXACTLY, which is both the schedule's printed page subtotal (300) and its printed grand total (300). Those two figures are the whole gate. This is ADDENDUM E5/F6's 'a document with NO summary page has no Column A' case: no Column A, no Column B, no balance ladder, nothing to promote and nothing to difference. `filing_totals.csv` publishes BLANK stated totals for this filing, and the rows here are published alongside that blank, never in place of it. The amounts are written without decimals ('100', '200') as are both printed footers ('300'); they are read as whole dollars, which the two footers confirm to the cent.

The contributions side has no page at all, so no in-kind question arises there.
